"Change and loss are two different things. Just because you became something different doesn't mean you lost yourself."

She tilts her head. "I think you won't be the *same* Bo, but you're still Bo."
I can sing to some stuff in Japanese but only if I'm actively listening to it at the time
Also, i prefer the English translations from the entire Swedish version of the *Carolus Rex* album. Just better imo
`Yeah, Sab really found herself after froggification. That's a word now, fight me. She didn't have to be scared of people wanting her double-dead any more.`
Orphy laughs. `Hahaha! Yeah, now she just has to be scared of people wanting her normal-dead.`
`Well, yeah, but don't we all?`
"Do not we all indeed." Irynx nods.
Also also, speaking of Japanese, *Shiroyama* is the next song
Bo smiles.
"The ravens gave me this body." His smile falters. Lucy nudges him. "I wonder if Ma will ever accept me like this."
`People who actually care about you will accept you for who you are. Shame we were too deep in despair to realise that one before.`

"Ravens gave me my old body back too, and my current one. And also technically they also gave me Eurus so they also gave me this body." The white raven does a nice little booty wiggle. "I'm sure you can get your old form back somehow. Lots of possibilities in this city."
Bo shakes his head. "Naw, think I might try and keep this one for a while." He laughs
"Heh. I actually didn't want my old one much anyway, when I went to the ravens. Was I glad to have it? Yes. But all I really wanted was out of my old one."
"Going to the ravens was a new start for me, and as fine as I was having my old self back, I don't think it was right to ring in the new life in old bones. Literal bones, not Old Bones."

`Honestly, we still don't even know what Sab was before... well, no, I guess what whoever she inherited the body from was. It's something it'd be nice to find out if it comes up, but... it's not a key facet of existence any more.`
Bo laughs hysterically
"And i gave my body to bring bones back!"
(The irony in having a friend named bones lol)

"If I had to guess, she used to be a body that didn't want to lie down. Just kept on going. A skeleton that didn't want to carry a soul, made one of its own. That's Sabby. But that's a *crazy* thinking."
`Oh, I guess that's what that one Infernal proverb means. Your bones. My bones. Bones' bones. Bone bone bone.`
they shrug. `But then where did she---and where did I---come from?`
"Do you want more of my theories? My head's all over the place sometimes, I can't promise you they're correct."
`Sure. It's always something to think about.`
`How can I be lost childhood memories without a childhood to spawn from?`
"Wait, how do you know that you're lost childhood memories? I didn't think about that. Catch me up there."
Bo yawns
`It's just a theory we had as to why she unconsciously remade the booths here. But I guess I latched onto it because purpose.`
"Didn't she remake the booths while she was still, uh, tied to that writhing mass of horrors or whatever you called it?"
`Yeah, so we'd prefer that it was me or the fae causing her to do that rather than. It.`
Bo plays music for the group as Lucy beams light around giggling.
"Well, you being lost childhood memories and then also that bit about the mass of horrors is.... a little mean to yourself? Just saying."
`It is? You'd think childhood would be before It came into play.`
`Who makes a pact with a mass of horrors as a kid? Is that even legal?`
"Well, when did you come into the picture, then? Before or after It?"
`See, neither of us remember. I was there when she woke up for the first time, which implies I was there before that, but how long before?`
"Bit of a stretchy implication there."
`Given my... state at the time... I could well have been related to It somehow.`
`But then at the same time, I remember very little of the time before Sab learned to summon me... so like the Ravens said about her, was that really me?`
"Hm. I think you follow very different rules from me and Orphy."
`All I know is the standard-issue familiar summoning ritual works for me, but I don't know if anything different comes of being a Guide...`
"As from me and Lucy."
`Who even assigned me that role? I don't remember. I just came into existence with it.`
"Hmmm... I wonder...."
Bo closes his eyes... He begins to thing hard...
(Since Lucy can project images to yall, I'm asuming I can do the same to her? Or she can see what I'm thinking?....)

"Orphy was a friend, first. I learned to summon him because I needed a friend. And then everything with the ravens happened, and they gave me Eurus. She watches over me, so I can watch over Empire City. Orphy became the sort of.... seal of our pact?"
(you can telepathically communicate with your familiar so long as you're in range)
(Well I'm sitting beside her lmfao)
(yeah range is like 100 feet (or same plane with Voice))
`And.... that's why I'm just a raven. A weird one, but always gotta look like a raven.`
(Either way.... Hmmmm)
`I'm just... I'd like to think I'm a friend?`
"Oh! New thought!"
`My job is to guide, but she's been needing my guidance less recently, I've been trying to guide others too---hm?`

"I've had Orphy for a while, but he changed after my pact with the ravens. I know I said we probably follow different rules but it could be the same with you and Sabby. You used to be something, but It changed you. And the Mender changed you again."

(so guess who realised recently goodberry is a touch spell)
`Yeah, perhaps... I can tap into a little of his power too now. Watch this.` they make a hand motion and a shower of berries fall into the leaves.
(that means you can cast it through a familiar, damn.)
Bo smiles warmly. "My deal... Is to make friends... That's the only thing I was asked to do." He chuckles. "I had a weapon, but it came to be... It caused fear more than friendship..."
Irynx and Orphy pick some berries together and nibble on it.
"That's not a bad pact, Mr. Bo!"
(though re-reading it I think I have to be in 100 feet range even with voice of the chain master, oops, so I just. won't do that at this distance again :v)
`Friendship, huh? Friendship, unity, that's always a good thing.`
"I wouldn't mind if the ravens just told me I should be friends with people."
Bo smiles down at Lucy... "Thats when she gave me Lucy."
`Who'd you make a deal with, anyway? Sounds like it's not Mr. Sandwich.`
"Oh, Lucy does such a good job of making friends."
An image flashes in the group's head. (Will post picture then delete 👀 )

Irynx falls out of the tree in surprise, and Orphy dives down to catch her and drag her back up to the branches.

"Sorry! Not used to the tiny talons."
Kukudh blinks a lot. `Huh, and I thought I was used to things being more vibrant now.`
Secel drops a silver into the drop box and makes her way to the docks
Bo smiles. "Spectra... I do hope to visit again."
"Also, who is Mr. Sandwich?"
Lucy purs with happiness
"...do you mean Maud?"
`The guy Bo was apprenticed to. Saw him buying like... twenty sandwiches at once one time.`
"You mean Mr. Malathor?"
Bo chuckles.
`Yeah, Mr. Sandwich.`
"I haven't seen him in a while but he's nice. I know Mr. Mender said it's a... complicated situation but, well."
"Mr. Bo turned out for the better, didn't he?"
She stays out until the improvised dye dries before making her way to bed.
Bo shrugs "he's a great friend... I almost died a few nights ago to some green rock... But he saved me."
"Glad to hear it. Empire City would be a sadder place if you died to a green rock... or died at all."
16 models down, 31 to go
`Yeah, we might have disagreements, but we can get along. That's unity, right?`
"Sort of?"
"Unity's other things."
Bo smiles. "I hope I can count you all as friends." He chuckles. "The more the merrier!" Lucy begins to spin backflips in the air, spreading happiness.
"You always have a friend with me, Mr. Bo. We fought existential dread together! Not very well, admittedly, but still!-- Oh, new thought!" She snaps her head back to Kukudh.
"The Noir brings memories to life!"
"That's why there's all sorts of monsters in there, because the only memories people feel like throwing away are the bad ones. And they grow legs and walk around the Noir being creepy and deadly."

`...are you saying we might have come from there? But Sab's earliest memory is being thrown out of a small village by Redcoats... though admittedly she doesn't have many memories before reaching the City. Just a couple of flashes of events.`
"What if you are *literally* lost childhood memories? Given life!"
"Eh. Didn't say the thought had to make sense."
`No, it's still something to think about. Thanks.`
"No problem. Thanks for being here too. I don't usually have this big of an audience when I'm announcing my brain words."
`Would explain being able to turn into a bird, too. Though not a spider or rat...`
`Don't worry, I'm used to listening. It's my job~`
`You and me both, kid.`
`Also Eurus, if she happens to be listening in there.` Orphy waves a black wing in front of Irynx's face.
Bo's eyes widen. "Uh...." Lucy looks slightly shocked, but happy.
`You alright there? Well, half-right. Half-left.`
Bo looks to Lucy and smiles. "Yeah, I think we're ok." Lucy purs.
`Half-right and half-left? That's just the whole thing!`
`Exactly! So if that isn't the case, something's wrong~`

"Well, it was a lovely night with you folks. It's well past midnight now. The birds and I are going to go and watch over Empire City now. Literally." She flaps her wings twice, then takes off. 

`The birds? It is quite literally just me! Not even Eury!` He follows and takes to the skies.
